body:
Goal: Write unit tests for slugify.py.
Task: T1 is yours. You own tests/test_slugify.py.
Reviewer: Reviewer.
Instructions:
- Write unit tests for slugify.py in tests/test_slugify.py using the standard library unittest only (no pip installs).
- Cover slugify (normal text, punctuation, max_len) and parse_duration (valid and invalid input).
- Run 'hermes-crew verify python -m unittest discover -s tests -v' so the verification result is recorded.
- If a test shows a real bug in slugify.py, do NOT edit slugify.py: tell the lead what you found.
- When tests are written and passing hermes-crew verify, mark task done: hermes-crew task done T1
